evidence_class: Mocked Redis server (fakeredis with Lua) and fixture server clock; signed fixture launch grants; no live controller service or deployment.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.api.server.serve(api, host, port) returns a ThreadingHTTPServer that serves POST /v2/executions/register and PUT /v2/executions/{id}/heartbeat with JSON bodies of at most 65536 bytes; the controller process starts it with its ExecutionsAPI
ExecutionsAPI.route for POST /v2/executions/register and PUT /v2/executions/{id}/heartbeat, register, heartbeat, command_watermark
heartbeat_rejections and heartbeat_rejections_total per error class
LaunchAuthority.bound authenticates a registered, current launch grant
TaskAuthority.renew accepts a RenewalFence; the COMMIT script refuses an older or altered renewal sequence before any lease write and admits an identical retry
urn:swarm-v2:heartbeat gains optional archive_watermark (default 0) and resources (default empty)

supported_versions.heartbeat_contract: major 2, minors 2.0 to 2.1 read; producers write 2.1
supported_versions.redis: Redis 7 with Lua, server TIME for lease deadlines

authority: Actor and scope derive from the registered launch grant and the execution registry; the URL subject must equal the credential's execution; display names confer nothing.

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent fake Redis state and matched the committed results; archive_watermark is observed, worker-reported, not externally verified.
states.accepted: Heartbeats renew only the bound execution's task lease at server time; forged subjects, other epochs, stale generations and older sequences are refused without writes.
states.committed: Code, fixture and case results at tested_commit.
states.externally_verified: None: no controller HTTP service mounts the routes yet and no G3 deployment was exercised.

rollback_rehearsal.action: LaunchAuthority.disable: new grants refused forbidden_scope, unregistered grants revoked so their registration is refused unauthenticated, registered executions keep heartbeating until their leases drain.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: Execution registry, launch grant audit rows and registrations, task authority and claim journal, heartbeat records and renewal fences; none are deleted by rollback.

remaining_limitations: The heartbeat credential is the launch grant (at most 900 seconds); credential rotation is a ledger follow-up.
archive_watermark is worker-reported and not verified against an archive authority.
command_watermark is provisional: the count of non-spawn runtime operations for the execution until the commands endpoint defines a cursor.
A heartbeat whose renewal committed before a newer one but whose record write landed after it is refused 409 although its lease renewal was in order.
No deployed controller process starts serve() yet; the antoncore controller service package wires it with the controller's LaunchAuthority, TaskAuthority and listen address.
